mainEntity.name: How do you ensure FAQ content remains accurate and up-to-date for AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining accuracy involves a regular content audit schedule. This includes periodically reviewing each FAQ for changes in products, services, policies, or industry best practices. Utilizing analytics to see which FAQs are most accessed or lead to conversions can also inform update priorities. Outdated information can negatively impact user trust and AI search rankings, so consistent review is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accuracy is ensured through regular content audits, reviewing FAQs for product/service changes, and using analytics to prioritize updates, as outdated info harms trust and rankings.
